lines.text: Welcome to Venice Beach Court! Boardwalk on the mic, sand on the court, sun on the water, and the pier is watching!
Venice, say hello! It's Boardwalk, live from the loudest slab of concrete between the pier and Dogtown!
Drum circle, drop a beat! Skaters, roll on in! Tourists, phones up! Boardwalk has the mic, and Venice Beach Court is open!
What's good, beach people! Sun going down, lights coming up, tacos on the grill, and Boardwalk on the mic. Let's run it!
When I say Venice, you say Beach! Venice!
Pier side, where you at?! Taco stand side, you're louder! Prove me wrong!
Big love to the drum circle! Give me a beat, give me a beat!
Where my Dogtown skaters at? Tap those decks on the concrete!
Captain Sunscreen, front row since noon! That's dedication, Venice!
Sand side, surf side, taco side too! Venice, let me hear you!
Taco stand just sold twelve tacos to one person. Twelve! That's a whole team's lunch!
Sun's sinking into the ocean like a soft free throw. Venice, that's a make every night!
Twenty years on this mic, and the seagulls still think they run this court. They don't. I do.
Dogtown kids rolling by on the bike path, doing tricks nobody asked for. Respect! Venice never sits still.
Lifeguard tower says the water's perfect. Boardwalk says the court is hotter. Who you trusting?
Churro cart rolling by. Cinnamon in the air, sand on the court. That's the Venice combo meal!
Breeze coming off the ocean, so if your shot drifts left, blame the Pacific. That's the rule.
Court rule since forever: loser buys the lemonade. The lemonade stand loves a close game.
Tide is coming in! You feel that, Venice?
Ooh, the kid's finding a rhythm out here!
Warm sand, warmer shots! Keep it coming!
High tide, Venice! Everybody on your feet!
Sizzling sand! Somebody bring this hooper some water!
Phones up, tourists! You'll want this one!
Riptide! This beach can't handle it!
Boardwalk approved, stamped, and framed! Can't miss!
Ocean's boiling, Venice! Whole pier is up!
Somebody call the lifeguard, the sand's melting!
Low tide, kid. It always comes back.
Little sand in your shoes? Shake it out!
Building sandcastles with those bricks! Next one drops!
That's a wrap, Venice! Boardwalk approved! Take a bow, and take the sunset with you!
Write it in the sand, the tide can't wash this one away! You ran Venice!
Venice Beach, on your feet for the winner! Honorary local, starting right now!
Game, set, sunset! The kid came to the beach and took the whole boardwalk home!
Not today, but the tide always comes back in. Venice will be here. Run it back!
Big respect! You left it all on the sand. Grab a taco and come back hungry!
Venice, give it up anyway! That's a hooper who'll be back, and Boardwalk will be waiting!
Sand in your shoes means you're coming back. Rematch is on the house, my friend!
